name: Violin
description: A versatile orchestral instrument known for its expressive tone.

name: Viola
description: A warm-toned bowed instrument slightly larger than a violin.

name: Cello
description: A lower-pitched bowed instrument with a rich, resonant sound.

name: Double Bass
description: The largest and lowest-pitched standard orchestral string instrument.

name: Acoustic Guitar
description: A portable string instrument played by strumming or fingerpicking.

name: Electric Guitar
description: A guitar that uses pickups and an amplifier to shape its sound.

name: Ukulele
description: A small four-string instrument with a bright, cheerful tone.

name: Piano
description: A keyboard instrument with hammers that strike strings.

name: Digital Keyboard
description: An electronic keyboard offering a range of instrument sounds.

name: Organ
description: A keyboard instrument that produces sustained tones.

name: Flute
description: A high-pitched wind instrument played by blowing across an opening.

name: Clarinet
description: A woodwind with a flexible range and mellow lower register.

name: Saxophone
description: A brass-bodied woodwind frequently heard in jazz and pop.

name: Oboe
description: A woodwind known for its focused, penetrating sound.

name: Trumpet
description: A bright brass instrument commonly used in bands and orchestras.

name: Trombone
description: A brass instrument that changes pitch primarily with a slide.

name: French Horn
description: A coiled brass instrument known for its rounded orchestral tone.

name: Drum Kit
description: A set of drums and cymbals used to keep rhythm.

name: Xylophone
description: A tuned percussion instrument with wooden bars.

name: Tambourine
description: A handheld percussion instrument with jingles.
